req.title: POST-only actions reject GET
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when GET is used on /<id>/delete.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 405 HTTP status code when a GET request is made to an endpoint that only supports POST requests. This behavior ensures that the system correctly enforces HTTP method constraints, which is crucial for maintaining the integrity and security of the application. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this requirement.

tests.name: test_post_only_action_rejects_get_positive
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as user with id 1
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Positive test: GET request to POST-only endpoint
r = client.get('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_post_only_action_rejects_get_negative
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as user with id 1
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Negative test: POST request to POST-only endpoint
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
